title: Algerian Tortilla Quesadilla
description: A flavorful twist on a classic quesadilla, this Algerian-inspired dish features zesty and garlicky flavors.
instructions: Heat a large non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Place a tortilla in the skillet and spread a quarter of the hummus on half of the tortilla.
Sprinkle a quarter of the cheese, some parsley, and a pinch of harissa on top of the hummus.
Fold the tortilla in half to enclose the filling.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the tortilla is crispy and the cheese is melted.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the other side is crispy.
Cut the quesadillas into wedges and serve hot.
